messages:
maria: Quick alignment — planning a coordinated version bump to 0.15.0 across API, runtime, console, and SDKs. Target cut window: Wed EOD (UTC). Can each codeowner confirm PR readiness and any migration notes?

devon: API ok from my side. PR is open: https://git.redwood/api/pulls/482 — needs one more review for the auth header change. No schema changes. Changelog entry in PR. :+1:

sam: Runtime: working on quantization patch that must land with the bump. PR is drafting, depends on a tiny API helper Devon added. ETA: today EOD. Heads-up: we need to bump the model-runtime compatibility table in console.

lee: Console: I'll update the compatibility matrix and changelog once both PRs are merged. Small UI copy tweak to call out the runtime opt-in. I can cut the console PR tomorrow morning. :eyes:

maria: Thanks. Two coordination notes: 1) branch naming convention: release/0.15.0/<repo>. Please use that for cutoff gating. 2) Changelogs must include migration steps for any breaking flags.

devon: +1 on branch. Also reminder to update SDKs to pin the API client schema version (we had a regression last time).

sam: Release-bot: please schedule a canary job after runtime PR merges.

release-bot: Canary job scheduled: buildkite.com/redwood/runtimes/canary-0.15.0 (status: queued). I will post results in this thread.

taylor: SDKs: I'm updating JS and Python clients. Will do a compatibility test matrix against local runtime canary. Expect PRs by tomorrow afternoon. Note: bump will require a minor change in instantiation API (named param renamed) — adding migration snippet in PR template.

lee: Quick question — do we want a grace period before flipping default quantization? If runtime opt-in is behind a flag, let's keep default off for one release to avoid surprises.

maria: Good call. Let's keep default off for 0.15.0, document the flag in console, and plan to flip in 0.16 unless we see broad adoption. Action items: Devon merge API helper, Sam finish runtime PR, Taylor open SDK PRs pinning schema, Lee prepare console changelog. If anything slips, ping here and we'll postpone cutoff by 24h.

devon: I'll aim to merge today after one more review. Ping @sam for dependency link once merged. :shipit:

sam: Noted. Will rebase on Devon's merge and trigger canary.

release-bot: Canary build completed: runtimes/canary-0.15.0 — success ✅. No regressions in perf tests.

maria: Awesome. If no blockers by 18:00 UTC tomorrow, we'll proceed with release cut. Thanks everyone.
